📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior software engineer designing scalable market-data services for Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure.
Building APIs and production systems for stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange data.
Senior engineer building scalable market-data infrastructure for Alpaca’s brokerage APIs
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Linux, Shell Scripting, SQL
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors UK Skilled Worker visas.
- Design highly scalable, mission-critical market data provider services
- Maintain good software quality and test coverage
- Participate in code reviews
- Troubleshoot incidents and reported bugs
- Help build and scale the systems and services underlying Alpaca's brokerage infrastructure
- Improve the architecture connected to stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange data products
- Oversee public API structure and documentation for streaming and historical endpoints
- Plan, ideate, experiment, and productionize new services and libraries to address scaling challenges
- BSc/MSc or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field
- Minimum 3 years of backend software development experience
- Hands-on experience with Docker or Kubernetes
- DevOps mindset
- Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies
- Experience building and architecting systems at scale
- Deep understanding of POSIX-like operating systems, modern infrastructure, and orchestration practices
- Nice-to-have: experience with large datasets

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior software engineer designing scalable market-data services for Alpaca’s brokerage infrastructure.
Building APIs and production systems for stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange data.
Senior engineer building scalable market-data infrastructure for Alpaca’s brokerage APIs
Role description:
• Design highly scalable, mission-critical market data provider services
• Maintain good software quality and test coverage
• Participate in code reviews
• Troubleshoot incidents and reported bugs
• Help build and scale the systems and services underlying Alpaca's brokerage infrastructure
• Improve the architecture connected to stocks, options, crypto, and foreign exchange data products
• Oversee public API structure and documentation for streaming and historical endpoints
• Plan, ideate, experiment, and productionize new services and libraries to address scaling challenges
Role requirements:
• BSc/MSc or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of backend software development experience
• Hands-on experience with Docker or Kubernetes
• DevOps mindset
• Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies
• Experience building and architecting systems at scale
• Deep understanding of POSIX-like operating systems, modern infrastructure, and orchestration practices
• Nice-to-have: experience with large datasets
• Nice-to-have: Kubernetes experience; CKA or CKAD certification is a plus
• Nice-to-have: SQL experience
• Nice-to-have: IP networking experience
• Nice-to-have: understanding of financial markets
• Nice-to-have: experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure
• Nice-to-have: shell scripting, Linux, Docker, microservice architectures, and clean code principles
